'''O'kar A'ko''' was the leader of the [[Ravagers]],<ref name="Codex" /> a notorious [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]],<ref name="Ravagers">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=codex|Ravagers}}</ref> in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Known as a vicious tyrant, A'ko was deposed in a near-[[Blood/Legends|bloodless]] mutiny led by the charismatic Ravager [[Ruugar]], who succeeded A'ko as [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the gang and led them for many years afterwards.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
O'kar A'ko was mentioned in the Codex entry for Ruugar in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']], the [[2014]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
